name: v4_start_frame
prompt:
Three round metallic discs laid flat on a dark matte black surface:
bright yellow-gold disc on the left with polished mirror-like metallic finish,
cool silver disc in the center with smooth reflective surface,
warm copper-bronze disc on the right with rich metallic sheen.
Each disc is thick and heavy-looking, slightly raised from the surface.
A hand holding a metal palette knife at a low angle, blade hovering just above the gold disc.
Top-down flat lay, close-up, straight down 90 degrees, shot from directly above.
Soft diffused studio lighting from two sides, metallic surfaces catching bright highlights and reflections.
Vertical 9:16, three discs arranged in a horizontal row centered in frame.
Photorealistic product photography, ultra-detailed.
No text, no watermarks, no logos.
